rationale: Pulp's standalone and headless screenshot runs now log which GPU adapter was chosen, how long each Dawn startup stage took, and what the finite run's frames cost. GpuSurface gains a StartupTimings value and a defaulted virtual startup_timings() appended at the vtable tail, which the Dawn surface fills in initialize() with monotonic stage timings; WindowHost gains defaulted virtual frame_time_samples_ms() and log_gpu_diagnostics_summary() appended at its vtable tail, implemented by the macOS host. Existing subclasses keep their slot layout and base implementations report nothing measured, so no rendering, presentation, adapter selection or retained-UI behaviour changes. Pulp-only: the diagnostics serve Pulp's standalone and screenshot tooling and originate here, with no counterpart framework change to backport.
